# Tropic Hands CEO Reins to Justin Etkin
By
[Steve Brooks](https://www.enterprisetimes.co.uk/author/stevebrooks/)
-
August 13, 2026

...

Appointment - (c) 2018 Image by Felix Wolf from Pixabay https://pixabay.com/photos/to-graduate-door-wood-entrance-3083812/ Tropic has appointed [Justin Etkin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/justintropic/) as CEO.
Etkin, a Co-Founder previously COO, takes over the role from fellow Co-Founder [David Campbell](https://www.linkedin.com/in/davidtropic/) , who becomes Chairman of the Board. Campbell will remain active, acting as an advisor with a focus on go-to-market strategy and broader corporate initiatives.

...

## Who is Justin Etkin?
Justin Etkin, CEO, Tropic (image credit - LinkedIn/Justin Etkin) Justin Etkin, CEO, Tropic
Since co-founding Tropic with Campbell in 2019, Etkin has played a central role in shaping the company’s product strategy. He helped design the solution that embeds Tropic’s proprietary spend and negotiation intelligence directly into customer workflows.

...

He spent three years at Bain & Company and was VP of Operations at Wunderkind for three and a half years before setting up Tropic to solve the inefficiencies and inequities buyers faced when purchasing Software.

# Tropic Ocean Airways Announces Leadership Transition
## 09 Oct Tropic Ocean Airways Announces Leadership Transition
**Fort Lauderdale, FL – October 7, 2025** – [Tropic Ocean Airways](https://flytropic.com/) today announced a leadership transition as Founder and CEO Rob Ceravolo steps down after 16 years at the helm to assume a new role as Board Member and Strategic Advisor.

...

“I’ve always believed that good leadership is about building something that lasts beyond you. After 16 years leading this company, Tropic is ready for me to step back from the CEO role and day-to-day operations,” said Ceravolo.

...

Effective immediately, Jason Schmidt, who has served as Tropic’s Chief Financial Officer for nearly a decade, will assume the role of Chief Executive Officer, guiding the company through its next phase of growth.
